text:
alex: Hey sec — quick approval request. We hit a migration replay bug and need to capture the full request+response for one canary instance to reproduce. That would include headers and prompt text. Plan: enable for a single canary for ~2 hours, write to an ephemeral CloudWatch log group with KMS, 24h retention, access limited to me + luca. Asking if that is OK or if we need stricter redaction before enabling.

maria: Do not log raw Authorization bearer tokens or unredacted PII. Can you explain why raw prompt text is required vs a hashed/sampled copy? If you absolutely need it, we need to redact tokens and sensitive fields, and an explicit manager + sec approval.

alex: The replay requires exact prompt sequences (including system prompts) because the bug only reproduces with order/spacing. We can hash user IDs but some prompts contain dynamic session state. Proposed safeguards in PR:
```yaml
logging:
  group_name: "/redwood/tmp/migration-debug-canary"
  retention_days: 1
  kms_key: "alias/research-debug"
  allowed_roles: ["alex","luca"]
  redaction:
    headers: ["authorization"]
    regex_scrub:
      - "(?i)email: \S+@\S+"
      - "(?i)ssn: \d{3}-\d{2}-\d{4}"
```
Can we get a short exception if that looks OK? PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/service/pull/8123

maria: That config is a good start but strip the full `Authorization` header at ingest (do not log it at all). For prompts: please add a prompt-scrubber step that replaces email-like tokens and credit-card-like patterns before persisting. Use one-way hashing for session IDs instead of storing raw IDs. Also require explicit manager approval sent to security.

devops-bot: Created ticket INFRA-4723: ephemeral-log-group-for-migration-debug (assigned to luca). Link: https://infra.redwood/INFRA-4723

jordan: I reviewed the PR and sec suggestions. I'm okay with a 2-hour capture window only if: 1) `Authorization` removed at ingest, 2) retention <= 24h, 3) access only to alex & luca, 4) logs destroyed afterward and we document the deletion. Approving conditionally. :+1:

luca: I'll implement the scrubber and one-way hash for session ids. Will add an audit log for who accesses the group and a post-mortem note. Will tag @maria on the PR and attach the test plan.

sre-oncall: Also ensure we don't accidentally route the canary through any external logging sink (sumologic/newrelic). Lock down the log group policy and enable access logging for the group.

maria: Once PR is updated with the scrubbing code and the ticket exists, I can sign off. Please include unit tests showing emails/ccn/ssn patterns are sanitized.

alex: Thanks — will push an update today and ping when the ticket + PR have the scrub logs/tests. We'll only enable after sec sign-off.
